audio.noAudio.where: Perform mode, audio track viewer: empty state when the row has no audio file

audio.loading.where: Perform mode, audio track viewer: spinner label while the audio loads

audio.notFound.where: Perform mode, audio track viewer: error when the audio can't be played

audio.labelWithTitle.where: Perform mode, audio track viewer: screen-reader label of the audio player

audio.label.where: Perform mode, audio track viewer: screen-reader label of the audio player when the song has no title

suggestions.opening.where: Perform mode, chart failed to load: toast after tapping a suggested chart
suggestions.opening.context: {fileName} is the chart file's name; 'chart' = sheet music

suggestions.searching.where: Perform mode, chart failed to load: line while looking for similar charts in the library
suggestions.searching.context: library = the congregation's collection of charts (sheet music)

suggestions.noMatches.where: Perform mode, chart failed to load: no similar charts were found

suggestions.searchLibrary.where: Perform mode, chart failed to load: button that opens the library search

suggestions.prompt.where: Perform mode, chart failed to load: heading above up to 3 suggested charts

chordEdit.editingChords.where: Perform mode, chord edit bar at the bottom of the screen: label while chord editing is on
chordEdit.editingChords.context: Chords = the chord symbols over a chart (sheet music)

chordEdit.editCount.where: Perform mode, chord edit bar: small badge counting unsaved chord edits

chordEdit.hint.where: Perform mode, chord edit bar: hint text (hidden on small screens)

chordEdit.cancel.where: Perform mode, chord edit bar: button that leaves chord editing

chordEdit.verifyDone.where: Perform mode, chord edit bar: button that marks the chart's chords as checked and leaves editing
chordEdit.verifyDone.context: Verify = confirm the chords on this chart are correct

chordEdit.popoverTitle.where: Perform mode, chord edit popover: small heading (shown uppercase)

chordEdit.deleteChord.where: Perform mode, chord edit popover: tooltip of the trash button

chordEdit.chordPlaceholder.where: Perform mode, chord edit popover: placeholder of the chord text field
chordEdit.chordPlaceholder.context: The field takes a chord symbol like Am7 (not translated)

chordEdit.set.where: Perform mode, chord edit popover: button that applies the typed chord

chordEdit.size.where: Perform mode, chord edit popover: label of the width nudge controls (shown uppercase)

chordEdit.narrower.where: Perform mode, chord edit popover: tooltip of the button that narrows the chord's cover box

chordEdit.wider.where: Perform mode, chord edit popover: tooltip of the button that widens the chord's cover box

viewer.noChart.where: Perform mode, image chart viewer: empty state

viewer.imageLoadFailed.where: Perform mode, image chart viewer: error when the chart image fails to load

viewer.retry.where: Perform mode, chart viewers: button that tries loading the chart again

viewer.retryWithCount.where: Perform mode, PDF chart viewer: Retry button after a failed attempt
viewer.retryWithCount.context: {attempt} is how many retries were made, {max} the limit (e.g. 'Retry (1/3)')

viewer.chartAlt.where: Perform mode, image chart viewer: alt text of the chart image when it has no title

viewer.loadingChart.where: Perform mode, PDF chart viewer: line under the loading skeleton

viewer.loadExhausted.where: Perform mode, PDF chart viewer: error heading after all retries failed

viewer.renderTimedOut.where: Perform mode, PDF chart viewer: error heading when drawing the chart timed out

viewer.renderTimedOutDetail.where: Perform mode, PDF chart viewer: detail line under the timeout heading

viewer.pdfLoadFailed.where: Perform mode, PDF chart viewer: error heading when the chart file fails to load

viewer.rendering.where: Perform mode, PDF chart viewer: spinner label while pages are drawn

viewer.pdfRenderError.where: Perform mode, PDF chart viewer: error when the PDF can't be drawn

viewer.measuring.where: Perform mode, PDF chart viewer: brief spinner label while the screen size is measured

viewer.pageOf.where: Perform mode, PDF chart viewer: floating page counter pill
viewer.pageOf.context: {current} is the page in view, {total} the number of pages

viewer.scoreLabel.where: Perform mode, MusicXML chart viewer: screen-reader label of the score area

viewer.writtenKey.where: Perform mode, MusicXML chart viewer: key header, label before the key written in the score
viewer.writtenKey.context: Followed by a key name like F#m (not translated)

viewer.labeledKey.where: Perform mode, MusicXML chart viewer: key header, label before the key set on the setlist row
viewer.labeledKey.context: Followed by a key name like Bb (not translated)

viewer.key.where: Perform mode, MusicXML chart viewer: key header label (shown uppercase) before the musical key
viewer.key.context: Musical key; followed by a key name like D (not translated)

viewer.matchKeyLabel.where: Perform mode, MusicXML chart viewer: screen-reader label of the button that sets the row's key to the score's key
viewer.matchKeyLabel.context: {key} is a musical key name like F#m

viewer.matched.where: Perform mode, MusicXML chart viewer: match-key button after it worked

viewer.matching.where: Perform mode, MusicXML chart viewer: match-key button while saving

viewer.matchTo.where: Perform mode, MusicXML chart viewer: button that sets the row's key to the score's key
viewer.matchTo.context: {key} is a musical key name like F#m; the arrow means 'to'

viewer.renderingScore.where: Perform mode, MusicXML chart viewer: overlay while the score is drawn

viewer.musicXmlLoadFailed.where: Perform mode, MusicXML chart viewer: error when the score can't be loaded
viewer.musicXmlLoadFailed.context: MusicXML is a file format name

viewer.textFileLoadFailed.where: Perform mode, text chord-chart viewer: error when the chart file can't be downloaded

viewer.chartLoadFailed.where: Perform mode, text chord-chart viewer: error when the chart can't be shown

viewer.wrap.where: Perform mode, text chord-chart viewer: floating control bar, layout toggle showing 'wrap lines' mode
viewer.wrap.context: Short toggle label; the other state is music.viewer.fit

viewer.fit.where: Perform mode, text chord-chart viewer: floating control bar, layout toggle showing 'fit to width' mode
viewer.fit.context: Short toggle label; the other state is music.viewer.wrap

viewer.zoomOut.where: Perform mode, text chord-chart viewer: screen-reader label of the - button

viewer.zoomIn.where: Perform mode, text chord-chart viewer: screen-reader label of the + button

transposer.errorTitle.where: Perform mode, PDF chart: fallback title when the chord overlay crashes

transposer.editHint.where: Perform mode, PDF chart: hint pill at the top of the page while editing chords

transposer.aiBadge.where: Perform mode, PDF chart: tiny badge on the spot where a new chord is being detected

transposer.autoTransposed.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: note beside the musician's instrument when the chart was transposed for it

transposer.saving.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: status while saving the musician's transposition

transposer.saved.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: status after the musician's transposition saved

transposer.playingIn.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: the key the setlist row is played in
transposer.playingIn.context: {key} is a musical key name like Am (not translated)

transposer.chartKey.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: the key the chart is written in, shown after 'Playing in'
transposer.chartKey.context: {key} is a musical key name; chart = sheet music

transposer.scanning.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: small uppercase heading while chords are detected on the chart

transposer.detectedKey.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: small uppercase heading above the chart's detected musical key

transposer.waitingForScan.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: small uppercase heading before chord detection ran

transposer.reset.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: button that returns to the original key

transposer.transposeDown.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: screen-reader label of the down-a-semitone button

transposer.transposeUp.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: screen-reader label of the up-a-semitone button

transposer.originalKey.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: stepper value when not transposed

transposer.semitones.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: unit after the transposition amount (e.g. '+2 semitones'); same word for any amount in English

transposer.playAs.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: small uppercase heading above guitar shape buttons that set a capo

transposer.capoShort.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: small line under a guitar shape button

transposer.sameKey.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: small line under a guitar shape that is already the chart's key

transposer.shapes.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: chain 'G shapes → Capo 3 → sounds Bb', first part
transposer.shapes.context: {shape} is a chord shape name like G or Am (not translated)

transposer.capoFret.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: capo position (chain text and screen-reader label of the capo fret buttons)

transposer.soundsIn.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: chain 'G shapes → Capo 3 → sounds Bb', last part

transposer.capoYourGuitar.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: small uppercase heading above the 12 capo fret buttons

transposer.clearCapo.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: screen-reader label of the Off button

transposer.off.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: small button that removes the capo

transposer.capoOff.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: screen-reader label of the first capo fret button (no capo)

transposer.playInShapes.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: hint after 'Capo 3 →' telling the guitarist which chord shapes to play

transposer.chordsDetected.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: small footer line
transposer.chordsDetected.context: {chords} is the number of chords found, {count} the number of chart pages

transposer.verifiedBy.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: badge saying who checked the chart's chords

transposer.editChords.where: Perform mode, transpose menu: button that turns on chord editing
